title: 侧栏品牌区 · 渡岛船票（0.2.1-rc.5 真实侧栏 DOM）

assertions.message: 标题栏、侧栏和画布保持三个独立表面
assertions.expression: (() => { const strip = document.querySelector('.shellStrip'); const root = document.querySelector('.wtg9ga_root'); if (!strip || !root) return false; const dark = document.body.hasAttribute('data-ds-dark-theme'); return getComputedStyle(strip).backgroundColor === (dark ? 'rgb(31, 48, 52)' : 'rgb(231, 239, 229)') && getComputedStyle(root).backgroundColor === (dark ? 'rgb(48, 52, 68)' : 'rgba(250, 248, 243, 0.82)'); })()

assertions.message: 会话列表渐隐层读取与侧栏相同的底色
assertions.expression: (() => [...document.querySelectorAll('[id^="root-"]')].every((root) => { const fade = root.querySelector('.GAkraW_fade'); if (fade === null) return false; const sidebarColor = getComputedStyle(root).backgroundColor; return getComputedStyle(fade).backgroundImage.includes(sidebarColor); }))()

assertions.message: 三档侧栏都渲染出对应宽度的 60px 船票
assertions.expression: (() => { const roots = [...document.querySelectorAll('[id^="root-"]')]; return roots.length === 3 && roots.every((root) => { const button = root.querySelector('button[aria-label="新会话"]'); if (button === null) return false; const style = getComputedStyle(button); return style.height === '60px' && style.width === (root.id === 'root-180' ? '156px' : '216px'); }); })()

assertions.message: logo row 与船票都放开 DSH 的裁切，按钮内边距和圆角正确
assertions.expression: (() => [...document.querySelectorAll('[id^="root-"]')].every((root) => { const button = root.querySelector('button[aria-label="新会话"]'); if (button === null) return false; const row = button.parentElement; const own = getComputedStyle(button); const parent = getComputedStyle(row); return parent.height === '80px' && parent.overflow === 'visible' && own.overflow === 'visible' && own.padding === '0px' && own.borderRadius === '9px'; }))()

assertions.message: 纸面用透明 2px 边框露出连续底边，背景裁切与圆角一致
assertions.expression: (() => [...document.querySelectorAll('[id^="root-"]')].every((root) => { const button = root.querySelector('button[aria-label="新会话"]'); if (button === null) return false; const own = getComputedStyle(button); const paper = getComputedStyle(button, '::after'); return paper.content === '""' && paper.borderWidth === '2px' && paper.borderColor === 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)' && paper.borderRadius === own.borderRadius && paper.backgroundClip === 'padding-box' && paper.backgroundOrigin === 'border-box'; }))()

assertions.message: 底边和纸面缺口共用同一圆心，纸面切口比底边大 2px
assertions.expression: (() => [...document.querySelectorAll('[id^="root-"]')].every((root) => { const button = root.querySelector('button[aria-label="新会话"]'); if (button === null) return false; const own = getComputedStyle(button); const paper = getComputedStyle(button, '::after'); const centers = ['clamp(44px, 24%, 54px) 0px', 'clamp(44px, 24%, 54px) 100%']; return own.maskComposite === 'intersect, intersect' && paper.maskComposite === 'intersect, intersect' && centers.every((center) => own.maskImage.split(center).length === 2 && paper.maskImage.split(center).length === 2) && own.maskImage.includes('6.6px') && own.maskImage.includes('7.1px') && paper.maskImage.includes('8.6px') && paper.maskImage.includes('9.1px'); }))()

assertions.message: 薄荷票根贴住纸面边缘，并在窄侧栏收到 44px
assertions.expression: (() => [...document.querySelectorAll('[id^="root-"]')].every((root) => { const button = root.querySelector('button[aria-label="新会话"]'); if (button === null) return false; const mark = button.querySelector(':scope > span > span:has(.animal-island-brand__mark)'); if (mark === null) return false; const style = getComputedStyle(mark); return style.alignSelf === 'stretch' && style.height === '60px' && style.transform === 'none' && style.backgroundSize === '8px 8px' && style.maskImage.includes('100% 0px') && style.maskImage.includes('100% 100%') && (root.id === 'root-180' ? style.width === '44px' : Number.parseFloat(style.width) > 44); }))()

assertions.message: 虚线撕口居中压在票根边缘上
assertions.expression: (() => [...document.querySelectorAll('[id^="root-"]')].every((root) => { const button = root.querySelector('button[aria-label="新会话"]'); const mark = button?.querySelector(':scope > span > span:has(.animal-island-brand__mark)'); if (mark === null || mark === undefined) return false; const seam = getComputedStyle(mark, '::after'); return seam.right === '-1px' && seam.width === '2px' && seam.backgroundImage.includes('repeating-linear-gradient') && seam.backgroundImage.includes('5px') && seam.backgroundImage.includes('9px'); }))()

assertions.message: 字标脱离 DSH 24px 盒后仍完整落在船票纸面内
assertions.expression: (() => [...document.querySelectorAll('[id^="root-"]')].every((root) => { const button = root.querySelector('button[aria-label="新会话"]'); if (button === null) return false; const label = button.querySelector(':scope > span > span:has(.animal-island-brand__name)'); const name = button.querySelector('.animal-island-brand__name'); const strong = name?.querySelector('strong'); const small = name?.querySelector('small'); if (!label || !name || !strong || !small) return false; const labelStyle = getComputedStyle(label); const nameStyle = getComputedStyle(name); const strongStyle = getComputedStyle(strong); const smallStyle = getComputedStyle(small); const fontSize = Number.parseFloat(strongStyle.fontSize); const lineHeight = Number.parseFloat(strongStyle.lineHeight); const clearance = (lineHeight - 1.45 * fontSize) / 2 + 0.28 * fontSize; return labelStyle.padding === '0px 10px 0px 11px' && labelStyle.height === '60px' && labelStyle.overflow === 'visible' && nameStyle.overflow === 'visible' && nameStyle.lineHeight === '18px' && strongStyle.fontSize === '20px' && strongStyle.lineHeight === '24px' && smallStyle.marginTop === '1px' && smallStyle.lineHeight === '9px' && strong.scrollWidth <= strong.clientWidth && clearance >= 2; }))()
